d: Wavy, long ash-blonde hair with sweeping bangs frames a face of apparent young adulthood. The left eye is a pale grey, while the right eye is obscured by a red mark and a matching red hue. A slender build is dressed in a black, plunging halter-style outfit with silver metallic accents at the neck and red plated armor on the shoulder. Two black curved horns emerge from the head, with a small flower charm hanging from the right horn and a red marking extending from the left horn down onto the forehead.
